description.summary: what the user is doing, for the visual context engine

protocol.description:
The visual context engine builds the user's memory of their own work from what is on screen. The compositor is the only party that knows which window has focus, who owns it, when the user is typing and when the screen must not be looked at. This protocol hands that to one client, the context engine, in a form that carries no content: counts of key presses, never which keys; the existence of a selection, never its text.
Only the context engine can bind the manager global. One binding at a time.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

interface.name: crownos_context_manager_v1
interface.description: On bind the compositor describes every mapped window, then sends focus and session, and keeps the client current from then on.

entry.name: secret
entry.summary: the source marked the content as a secret

entry.name: typing_paused
entry.summary: no printable key for the pause threshold

request.name: set_paused
request.description: While paused the compositor sends no window, focus, activity or selection events and fails every capture the engine holds.

event.name: window
event.description: Its description follows on the new object and ends with done. The identifier is the one its ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 carries.

event.name: input_activity

description.summary: how much the user did in the focused window

event.description: Counts over the last interval, sent only when non-zero. Never the identity of a key. text counts printable keys, edit Backspace and Delete, nav arrows and paging, chords modifier combinations. Text counts are zero while the window is sensitive.

event.name: selection
event.description: Which selection, the window whose client set it, its mime types joined by commas and a size hint in bytes. Never the content.

interface.name: crownos_context_window_v1

description.summary: one toplevel, for the context engine

interface.description: Property events are followed by done; closed is last.

entry.name: visible
entry.summary: some of it is on a shown output

entry.name: password_input
entry.summary: a text input with password or pin purpose is active

entry.name: private_browsing
entry.summary: the title matched a private-browsing rule

entry.name: app_requested
entry.summary: the app excluded itself through crownos_capture_privacy_v1

entry.name: secret_text
entry.summary: a secret pattern was seen on screen

entry.name: user
entry.summary: the user asked through the engine

request.name: flag_sensitive

description.summary: treat the window as sensitive for a while

request.description: The engine saw something on screen that should not be captured. The compositor sets engine_flagged for duration_ms and fails captures of the window meanwhile.

event.name: process
event.description: The pid the kernel reported for the client; 0 when unknown.

event.name: sandbox

description.summary: the sandbox the client came from

event.description: The wp_security_context_v1 engine, app_id and instance_id, all empty for an unsandboxed client.
